news.note: The News tab composes Media, List Item, and Button. It is a sample screen, not a new component.

tokens.$comment: DDGDS foundations for agents. Light mode mirrors shared/design-tokens.json + Button registry paths. Run scripts/sync-foundations.mjs after editing shared tokens.

spacing.note: Base 4. 1 and 2 are the only steps off the grid. There is no 0.

$theme/color/control_fill_primary.note: Standard Rest. Figma Control/Fill-Primary paints black at 6%.

$theme/color/control_fill_secondary.note: Standard Hover. Figma Control/Fill-Secondary paints black at 9%.

$theme/color/control_fill_tertiary.note: Standard Pressed. Figma Control/Fill-Tertiary paints black at 12%.

$theme/color/platform_ios_key.note: iOS keyboard key. Platform chrome, not a DuckDuckGo brand colour.

$theme/color/platform_ios_return.note: Return key. The iOS system blue is #0088ff, which is 3.52:1 with white. This is the accent blue so the label clears 4.5:1.

$theme/color/platform_ios_return_dark.note: Dark keyboard return. The system blue #0a84ff with white is about 3.6:1, so this uses the accent blue, which clears 4.5:1.

$theme/color/platform_ios_label.note: iOS keyboard label on the dark board.

$theme/color/swipe_delete.note: Painted swipe delete. The node is brand/destructive at this red.

$theme/color/destructive_primary.note: Figma Button variable --ds-destructive-primary. White on this red is 4.65:1.

$theme/color/destructive_secondary.note: Figma Button variable --ds-destructive-secondary, used for hover.

$tokens/sizing__button_height_lg.note: The only button height. Controls painted at 44 use this same token. There is no size axis.

$tokens/corner_radius__button_lg.note: The button corner. Figma binds Mac/Button/Large, which is 6. It is the one radius off the scale. Only the button uses this name.

$tokens/sizing__control_48.note: Disclosure, the toggle object, and the AI composer.

$tokens/typography__family.note: Web UI stack. The first face is Figma News/UI/Web and Brand/Proxy/Family. Proxima Nova is the preferred product face in the news spec, but it is not licensed and Figma does not have it, so it is not shipped.

$tokens/typography__line_height_button.note: Button label line height. Figma paints 13.

$theme/color/destructive_swipe.note: iOS-style swipe delete from List Item audit

$tokens/typography__size_list_title.note: iOS list title. Figma paints SF Pro 17 Regular. The web face stays Inter.

$tokens/typography__size_list_title_andr.note: Android list title. Figma paints Roboto 16 Regular. The web face stays Inter.

$tokens/typography__size_list_details.note: iOS list details. Figma paints 13 Regular.

$tokens/typography__size_list_details_an.note: Android list details. Figma paints Roboto 14 Regular.

$tokens/typography__family_ui.note: Same family as Figma News/UI/Web and Brand/Proxy/Family.

$tokens/typography__family_editorial.note: Same family as Figma News/Editorial/Family. SIL Open Font License.

$tokens/typography__family_editorial_sta.note: Web adapter for News/Editorial/Family, with the spec fallbacks.

$tokens/typography__family_ios.note: Same family as Figma iOS/Global/Family and News/UI/iOS.

$tokens/typography__family_android.note: Same family as Figma Android/Global/Family and News/UI/Android.

$tokens/typography__news_label_family.note: Figma News/UI/Web. iOS uses SF Pro and Android uses Roboto for the same role.

$tokens/typography__news_caption_family.note: Figma News/UI/Web. iOS uses SF Pro and Android uses Roboto for the same role.

typography.note: Editorial text is Newsreader. Product UI is Inter. Duck Sans is the Figma brand face and is not shipped. iOS chrome stays SF Pro. Android chrome stays Roboto.

figma.note: Each size is one sheet from Icons & shells. Named glyphs are not separate files. Invisible 16 does not draw.

web.note: Stand-ins the web controls compose. They are not the Figma masters.

assets.note: A mark keeps its own colour and proportion. A glyph is a tool icon and can be tinted.
